title: AI and Data Center Stocks Slide on Texas Governor Upset
summary: Gotrade News - AI and data center stocks fell in overnight trading early Wednesday after the Associated Press projected Democrat Gina Hinojosa would
body_markdown:
## Nebius Group (NBIS) and Oracle (ORCL) Each Fall 4%


Nebius Group, a CoreWeave peer, fell 4%, and Oracle lost 4% on Robinhood, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/ai-stocks-texas-governor-data-centers.html) . The drops came with the tech sector already under pressure: the Nasdaq-100 fell into correction territory at the end of October amid concerns that data center spending growth by hyperscalers and AI firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic was slowing, CNBC reported.


## How Much Planned US Data Center Capacity Is in Texas?


Texas holds 27% of planned US data center gigawatts, according to Wells Fargo figures cited by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/ai-stocks-texas-governor-data-centers.html) , which also gave the shares for Georgia, Ohio and Pennsylvania:


State Share of planned US data center gigawatts (Wells Fargo, via CNBC)


Texas 27%


Georgia 7%


Ohio 5%


Pennsylvania 5%


Democrats were projected to win or retain the governorships in Georgia, Ohio and Pennsylvania as well, CNBC reported.


Ohsung Kwon, chief equity strategist at Wells Fargo, wrote that the equity market reaction from the midterms mostly depends on the outcome of the Texas governor's race, per CNBC.


## What Has Gina Hinojosa Said About Data Centers?


Hinojosa has called for "a moratorium on data centers until the legislature can meet to put in place real protections," according to an[August 10 statement from her campaign](https://ginafortexas.com/2026/08/statement-hinojosa-on-data-center-companies-supporting-abbotts-data-center-plan/) . In the same statement, she argued that Abbott's data center guidelines "aren't laws, they won't protect Texans."


The Associated Press called the race for Hinojosa at 10:17 p.m. on election night, as reported by[KUT and The Texas Newsroom](https://www.kut.org/politics/2026-11-03/texas-governor-election-2026-hinojosa-early-results) . With most of the reported vote counted, she had about 57% to Abbott's roughly 41%. Abbott conceded, saying "mathematically, we are not going to be able to win this election." Hinojosa takes office in January 2027 as the first Democrat to hold the office since Ann Richards left in 1995, per KUT.


## Midterm Data Center Risk: Bank of America and Optimal Advisory Warnings


Bank of America's Michael Hartnett warned earlier this year that Democrats winning the Senate, combined with taking the Texas governorship, could lead to a "big slump" in stocks of more than 10% into year-end, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/04/ai-stocks-texas-governor-data-centers.html) .


The Washington policy team at Optimal Advisory wrote that "data centers went from being a popular economic development tool in 2024 and 2025 to something of a pariah" during the midterm campaigns. The team added that "the midterms are likely to send a message to local and state officials that there is a political upside to blocking, delaying and/or raising the cost of data centers," CNBC reported.
